'''Kep Fortuna''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as the [[city manager]] of the [[High City of Refuge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kidron/Legends|Kidron]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Kep was a distant relative of [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]], the [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]].
